What is a white-label reseller program?

A white-label reseller program lets you sell a vendor's product under your own brand. You buy access at a wholesale rate, put your name and domain on it, set the retail price, and own the client relationship. The vendor stays invisible and runs the platform. You keep the margin for as long as the client stays.

It is worth separating from the deals vendors often lump in with it. A reseller sells the vendor's product for a cut, often with that brand still visible. A referral partner passes leads for a fee and does not deliver the service. An OEM embeds the vendor's technology inside its own product. White-label sits closest to owning the offer the client sees.
